claim_scores.rationale: Patches `litellm.completion`, constructs `dspy.LM(..., model_type="chat", reasoning_effort="low")`, and calls a non-OpenAI Anthropic chat model.
`FakeResp` exposes `choices`, `usage`, and `model`, matching the response fields DSPy reads for chat completion processing/history.
The fake chat function captures outbound kwargs, and the program asserts `captured[0]["reasoning_effort"] == "low"`.
The fake choice message includes both `content` and non-empty `reasoning_content`, and the asserted result preserves them as `text` and `reasoning_content`.
It asserts the parsed result is a one-element list containing a dict with both `text` and `reasoning_content`, which is why DSPy does not collapse it to plain strings.
